node.statement: Let R:=max_{1<=i<=r} sum_{j=1}^s |B_ij|. For every x in R^s with ||x||_infinity<=1 and every i, |(Bx)_i|=|sum_j B_ij x_j|<=sum_j |B_ij||x_j|<=sum_j |B_ij|<=R. Hence ||Bx||_infinity<=R, and taking the supremum in the definition of the induced norm gives ||B||_{infinity->infinity}<=R.
